statistical_failure_preservation_record.governance_mandate: Zero alteration of empirical failures. All statistical shortfalls and simulation limitations are documented transparently as permanent scientific records.
scientific_failure_diagnosis: 1. Small-sample downward variance bias: At N=30, the sample autocovariance estimator underestimates long-run variance.
2. Stationary block bootstrap compression: With average block length b=4, the stationary bootstrap fails to replicate the full low-frequency spectral density.
3. Inter-test correlation: HAC and bootstrap test statistics are strongly positively correlated (r > 0.90) on the same sample, causing concurrent spurious rejections.

4. Generalization caveat: All numerical findings are synthetic simulation results conditional on a stationary AR(1) Gaussian process; they do not represent universal mathematical properties of financial time series.
